rows.grounds: past participle of pīḍ, nominative plural

items.question: In how many womb-diagrams are beings tormented across eighty-four thousand births?
items.inference: Thus beings suffer torment across eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The exact gender and syntactic subject of pīḍitāḥ remain unresolved.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, they are tormented.
